d: The Indian-American vote is emerging as a significant Democratic stronghold in the United States. An HT analysis of the 2026 US midterm elections found that Democrats won 84 of the 100 congressional districts with the largest Indian-American populations. From California and New York to New Jersey and Illinois, Indian-American voters backed Democratic candidates, while Republicans held more ground in Texas.
